subject: MSA + Order Form — initial contract packet & priority questions
messages:
From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@stilledge.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Morgan Legal Ops <legal-ops@stilledge.com>
Date: Sat, 10 Apr 2027 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Stilledge MSA + Order Form (initial packet)

Hi Tessa,

Thanks for the quick intro earlier this week. As discussed on the call, attaching our proposed Master Services Agreement (MSA) and the Order Form spreadsheet with the product/seat counts. We'd like to move quickly — target go-live June 1 is what the product team is aiming for.

High-level asks from our side before we proceed to redlines:
- Can Redwood accept the data residency language in Section 7 (we prefer EU-only processing for EU customers but Stilledge will be US-first for this project)
- We're asking for 99.9% SLA on inference latency per the order (scope in Exhibit B) — want confirmation on your Dedicated offering fallback
- Please confirm your standard IP indemnity carveouts (we've highlighted Section 12)

Attached: Stilledge_MSA_v1_20270409.docx (track changes off), OrderForm_Stilledge.xlsx (line-item pricing). We'll expect an initial redline back by Tue 13 Apr to keep timelines. If you prefer, we can accept a redline email first and then a Word file.

Thanks — I'll be the primary contracting contact for Stilledge.

Alex Rivera
Director, Business Ops — Stilledge
alex.rivera@stilledge.com
+1 415-555-0143

Subject: Re: Stilledge MSA + Order Form (initial packet)

Alex — thanks for sending this over and for the clear timeline. Looping in Kimberly (contracts lead) and Marissa (onboarding/programs) so we can get alignment.

Quick read-through notes and next steps from our side:
- Kimberly will own the MSA redline and will aim to return a first-pass Word file.
- Marissa will review the Order Form mapping (billing/seat counts) and confirm invoice cadence.
- We will prioritize residency language and SLA items you called out. If we need any exceptions, we'll flag them in the redline.

Could you confirm which environment you plan to use (Hosted API vs Dedicated)? That affects the SLA and our fallbacks. Also confirm whether Stilledge requires a BAA or additional data protection annex — I've seen some customers ask for the DP Annex.

Planned timeline: Kimberly to return redline by Mon 13 Apr EOD (PST). If that slips, we'll send a short email with the specific clause exceptions so procurement can triage.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Sales Lead, Redwood Inference
Tessa.morgan@redwood.ai

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 09:26:00 -07:00
Subject: Stilledge — first-pass redline plan

Tessa / Marissa,

I completed a preliminary review of the MSA and the highlights below capture the things I'll address in-line. I'll return a tracked Word copy and a short exceptions list by end of day.

Primary items I'll focus on:
1) Data residency (Sec 7): Stilledge's ask is EU-only for EU customers. We can accept a narrow EU-processing clause for EU customer data but cannot rewrite global residency for the whole account. I'll propose language that allows region-specific residency commitments scoped to the order/exhibit.

2) SLA / availability (Exhibit B): Our Dedicated offering has latency SLOs and an uptime commitment for the serving control plane. We should propose a fallback where we commit to a performance SLA for Dedicated and a 95th-percentile latency target for Hosted with credits capped (standard in our playbook).

3) IP / indemnity (Sec 12–13): Flagging mutual indemnity and a carveout for open-source model components. I'll ask legal to include the standard Redwood carve: no indemnity for third-party open-source models and no warranty on model outputs.

4) Data processing annex / BAA: If Stilledge handles PHI we need a BAA; otherwise a DP Annex is usually acceptable. Kimberly to confirm after procurement call.

Attachments I'll include in return: Redwood_MSA_redline_tessa_v1.docx (tracked changes), clause-exceptions-20270412.pdf (short list).

If there are any commercial exceptions Stilledge has already signaled (e.g., extended payment terms), please add notes — I'll call them out.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Contracts Counsel, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Stilledge MSA + Order Form (initial packet)

Thanks Tessa and Kimberly — appreciate the quick turnaround. A few clarifications from Stilledge after internal alignment: 
- Environment: We'll be running a mix (Hosted for prototype, Dedicated for production). We want the MSA to allow the ability to move orders between hosting modes with 30 days' notice.
- BAA: No PHI in scope for initial project, DP Annex should be fine for now.
- Payment terms: Procurement will request Net 60; product team prefers Net 30. Could you call out whether that's something contracts can escalate?

We look forward to the tracked MSA and the Order Form mapping. If it's easier for you, you can send the redline to procurement@stilledge.com and I'll make sure it's routed.

Alex Rivera
Director, Business Ops — Stilledge
alex.rivera@stilledge.com
+1 415-555-0143
